notes.text:
This update for tomcat10 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-74048: Cryptographic policy bypass via FIPS activation failure (bsc#1286502).
- CVE-2026-74049: Jasper JSTL <c:redirect> plug-in implementation omits page abort (bsc#1286555).
- CVE-2026-88041: Information disclosure via incomplete HTTP trailer cleanup (bsc#1286559).
- CVE-2026-93446: Possible TLS 1.3 connection failures (bsc#1286571).
- CVE-2026-101296: Authentication bypass via non-GSSAPI SASL in JNDI realm (bsc#1286361).
- CVE-2026-101356: Information disclosure via incorrect object recycling in HTTP/2 processing (bsc#1286362).

Changes:

Update to Tomcat 10.1.61:

 * Catalina
 + Fix: When starting a web application, don't try and use the web
 application class loader until after the web application class loader
 has started. (markt)
 + Fix: various concurrency issues around adding and removing Realms from a
 CombinedRealm, in particular doing so while the CombinedRealm is in use.
 Note that once a Realm instance has been removed from a CombinedRealm
 instance at run-time, the removed Realm instance may not be reused apart
 from re-adding it to the same CombinedRealm. (markt)
 + Update: When StoreConfig re-writes an existing server.xml or context
 configuration file, preserve the layout of the existing file (comments,
 blank lines and attribute order) on a best effort basis. (remm)
 + Fix: Track in StandardContext whether the context was deployed from a
 Context element in server.xml. Use it to have StoreConfig save to a new
 config file. (remm)
 + Fix: Improve error handling on start-up. (markt)
 + Fix: byte range responses generated by DefaultServlet so a short
 resource stream read does not truncate the response. Treat a premature
 end of stream as an I/O error. Based on pull request #1067 by aoto-tech.
 (markt)
 + Fix: Align OpenSSLLifecycleListener with AprLifecycleListener and throw
 an Error when FIPS is requested but not available. (markt)
 + Fix: Ensure that, as per the documentation, a simple bind is always used
 when the JNDI realm binds using the user provided name and password to
 authenticate the user. (markt)
 + Update: Optimize Accept-Language header processing and use of resource
 budles for localization. (remm)
 * Coyote
 + Fix: 70236: Fix a stalled TLS handshake with the OpenSSL based
 implementations of SSLEngine when the first flight of handshake messages
 sent by the server is too large to fit in the buffer used by the BIO
 pair. Patch submitted by Lukas Hellebrandt. (remm)
 + Fix: #1073: Fix possible corruption when using HTTP/2 and async IO on
 uploads. Submitted by Tim Burke. (remm)
 + Fix: Avoid very rare race between async write notification and
 completion. Skip the write notification in these cases since it would be
 useless. (remm)
 + Fix: a timing issue that could cause large non-blocking writes to stall
 for AJP connections. (markt)
 + Fix: Ensure that the non-blocking write buffer is empty before sending
 an AJP end response message. (markt)
 + Fix: CharChunk.indexOf(char) so that it searches from the start of the
 chunk rather than from twice the chunk's start offset when the chunk
 does not begin at the start of its buffer. (breken-ai)
 + Fix: 70247: Fix a leak in the HTTP/2 connection flow control window when
 part of the HTTP request body is received but not read. Based on a patch
 provided by Guillaume Darmont. (markt)
 + Fix: 70251: Avoid closing a JarFile in CloseableURLConnection unless it
 is certain the JAR is not shared. (remm)
 + Fix: possible corruption of HTTP/1.1 chunked response bodies if a
 previous write to a chunked body fails. (markt)
 + Fix: Align cipher order with the results produced by OpenSSL if the
 cipher specification adds, removes and then re-adds ciphers. (markt)
 + Fix: Correct a narrow race condition when processing HTTP/2 headers.
 + Fix: possible TLS connections failures caused by one of the flags Tomcat
 uses to track TLS handshake progress not being correctly reset. (markt)
 + Fix: Allow for absolute host names in SNI checks. (markt)
 + Fix: Correct a gap in asynchronous error handling that could lead to
 unexpected IllegalStateExceptions for some error conditions. (markt)
 + Add: Harden HTTP/2 against applications that do not correctly handle
 asynchronous errors. (markt)
 * Jasper
 + Fix: Route JspC servlet context logging through Ant when used as an Ant
 task. (sainadh777)
 + Fix: the tag plugin for the JSTL <c:redirtect> tag so that page
 processing ends with the redirect. (markt)
 * Web applications
 + Add: Documentation: Explicitly state that virtual host matching via the
 HTTP host header and TLS configuration matching via SNI are completely
 separate processes. (markt)
 + Fix: Examples: Draw axis-aligned rectangles and ellipses as lines in the
 WebSocket drawboard. (sainadh777)
 * Other
 + Update: the internal fork of Apache Commons BCEL to 6.13.0. (markt)
 + Update: to NSIS 3.13. (markt)
 + Update: to Byte Buddy 1.18.14. (markt)
 + Update: to Bouncy Castle 1.8.6. (markt)
 + Add: Improvements to French translations. (remm)
 + Add: Improvements to Japanese translations provided by tak7iji. (markt)
 + Update: to Migration tool for Jakarta EE 1.0.13. (markt)
 * Cluster
 + Fix: Replicate SSO session key set changes made by removeSession() and
 sessionChangedId() in ClusterSingleSignOn so that SSO entries are
 correctly deregistered and removed from all nodes when the last
 associated session expires, even when the sessions expire on different
 cluster nodes. (remm)
 + Fix: Move context attributes that were set while the web application was
 still starting into the replicated attribute map when it is installed in
 ReplicatedContext, so that they are replicated to the other nodes like
 attributes set later on rather than remaining local to the node that
 started the application. (remm)
 + Fix: a possible deadlock in DeltaSession.expire(): the final session
 delta is now captured and sent to the cluster before the session monitor
 is acquired, because obtaining the delta takes the delta lock and code
 that runs while the delta lock is held, such as session attribute
 listener notifications, may in turn wait for the session monitor. (remm)
 + Fix: Fire the documented send_message_failure lifecycle event with the
 message, destination and exception when a SimpleTcpCluster message send
 fails and notifyLifecycleListenerOnFailure is enabled. The event was
 previously declared but never fired. (remm)
 + Fix: a possible deadlock in DeltaSession: session attribute listeners
 are no longer called while the delta lock is held when attributes are
 set or removed. The delta lock is only held while the change is
 recorded. (markt)
 + Fix: a possible deadlock in DeltaSession: received session deltas are
 now read into a separate DeltaRequest from the one the session uses to
 record local changes. This avoids having to hold the delta lock while
 processing received changes. (markt)
 + Fix: an issue replicating SessionListener additions and removals that
 meant some modification were not replicated leading to inconsistent
 listener configurations across the cluster. (markt)
 * Tribes
 + Docs: Document Tribes channel, membership, transport and replication
 status available through JMX. Based on pull request #1071 by sainadh777.

notes.text:
A missing critical step in authentication vulnerability in Apache Tomcat when the JNDI realm was configured with with a non GSSAPI SASL authentication mechanism  allowed attackers to authenticate without providing the correct password.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M1 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.0-M1 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.0.M1 through 9.0.122.



The following versions were EOL at the time the CVE was created but are known to be affected:  from 8.5.0 through 8.5.100, from 7.0.0 through 7.0.109.  Other unsupported versions may also be affected.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, 10.1.61 or 9.0.123, which fix the issue.

notes.text:
Incorrect object recycling and re-use vulnerability in Apache Tomcat affecting HTTP/2 processing of asynchronous servlets can trigger request and/or response mix-up between users.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.22 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.55 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.118 through 9.0.122.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, 10.1.61 or 9.0.123, which fixes the issue.

notes.text:
Not Failing Securely ('Failing Open') vulnerability in Apache Tomcat. If the  OpenSSLLifecycleListener is configured to use FIPS mode but FIPS activation fails, Tomcat logs and error but continues to use JSSE in non-FIPS mode with the provided configuration.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M14 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.22 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.92 through 9.0.122.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, 10.1.61 or 9.0.123, which fix the issue.

notes.text:
Execution After Redirect (EAR) vulnerability in Apache Tomcat.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M1 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.0-M1 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.0.M1 through 9.0.122.

notes.text:
Incomplete cleanup vulnerability in Apache Tomcat allowed an trailer information from a previous request to leak into a subsequent request.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M23 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.27 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.92 through 9.0.122.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, 10.1.61 or 9.0.123, which fix the issue.

notes.text:
Incomplete cleanup vulnerability in Apache Tomcat could cause TLS 1.3 connections to fail intermittently.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M21 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.25 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.90 through 9.0.122.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, 10.1.61 or 9.0.123, which fix the issue.
